name: Sid – optimised fraud-pattern features (sid/branch)

validation.description: Last 2,000 training transactions (31 Jul - 31 Aug 2026), held out

notes: Gradient boosting on hand-built fraud patterns (night-time, account takeover = unknown device + 3+ failed logins, abroad without travel notice, transfer to a new payee), leaving out columns with no fraud signal. Monthly backtest Jun-Aug: 3,905 points (441 caught, 61 false alarms, 20 missed).
